d1.problem: Two launch tasks are blocked because we have no tool to send the sign-up sequences. Which email tool do we commit to, knowing it has to be live before Oct 20?

vars.name: Deliverability
vars.ctx: Launch emails that land in spam cost sign-ups we cannot recover. We have no sending history yet, so the tool's own reputation carries us.

vars.name: Time to set up
vars.ctx: Michael has 5 h budgeted. Anything needing a developer or a domain warm-up longer than a week misses the launch.

vars.name: Cost at 5,000 contacts
vars.ctx: The KR targets 2,000 sign-ups; plan for 5,000 contacts within the quarter. Budget is tight until the first sales.

opts.name: All-in-one marketing suite
opts.desc: Email, landing pages and automations in one place. Powerful, heavier to learn.

opts.name: Lightweight newsletter tool
opts.desc: Simple sequences and forms, good deliverability, flat pricing.

opts.name: Transactional email API
opts.desc: Best deliverability and price, but forms and sequences must be built.

d2.problem: The launch offer and the sales pitch cannot be finalised without a price. What price structure do we launch the masterclass series with?

vars.name: Speed of the first 30 sales
vars.ctx: The €50k KR needs momentum in the first 10 days; the sales team needs a reason to call now.

vars.name: Perceived value
vars.ctx: A discount that looks permanent anchors the series low for every later cohort.

vars.name: Cash per sale
vars.ctx: Average order value target is €1,500. Instalments help conversion but delay cash.

opts.name: Early-bird then full price
opts.desc: €990 for 10 days, then €1,490. Creates urgency, keeps the anchor.

opts.name: Single price
opts.desc: €1,490 from day one. Clean anchor, no urgency lever.

opts.name: Payment plan
opts.desc: 3 × €530. Lowers the entry ticket, spreads the cash.

d3.problem: Sign-up page conversion fell from 26% to 18% after the offer change and the live sign-ups KR is red. What do we change to get back on track before Live #1?

vars.name: Speed of effect
vars.ctx: Live #1 is in 2 weeks. A fix that needs a new page or new traffic arrives too late.

vars.name: Effort
vars.ctx: Michael is at 97% load; the fix must fit in a few hours.

vars.name: Risk to the launch date
vars.ctx: Moving the date resets partner promotion and the sales calendar.

opts.name: Remove the price from the sign-up page
opts.desc: Keep the free sign-up free of any price signal; the price appears after the live.

opts.name: Move Live #1 to Oct 29
opts.desc: Two more weeks of acquisition at the current conversion.

opts.name: Partner co-promotion
opts.desc: Ask the 3 partner communities to push the live this week.

d4.problem: Home shoots needed too much editing to fix sound and light, and editing is the slowest step. Where do we shoot the masterclasses?

vars.name: Editing time
vars.ctx: Editing takes 5 d per masterclass today; the target is 3 d.

vars.name: Cost per shoot
vars.ctx: A studio day costs about €450; the home setup is already paid for.

vars.name: Scheduling flexibility
vars.ctx: Ilya and the speakers need to book slots at least a week ahead in a studio.

opts.name: Rent a studio
opts.desc: Controlled light and sound, one day per masterclass.

opts.name: Upgrade the home setup
opts.desc: Buy lights and a microphone, keep shooting at home.

opts.name: Hybrid
opts.desc: Studio for the main sequences, home for the short inserts.

d5.problem: Editing is the bottleneck of the production chain and delays every masterclass. How do we remove it?

vars.name: Production cycle time
vars.ctx: The target is a 14-day cycle by masterclass #3.

vars.name: Cost
vars.ctx: Budget allows one dedicated person part-time, not an agency retainer.

vars.name: Quality consistency
vars.ctx: Every masterclass must look like the same series.

opts.name: Dedicated freelance editor
opts.desc: One person who learns the format and the style guide.

opts.name: Agency on demand
opts.desc: Fast capacity, a different editor each time.

opts.name: Ilya edits in-house
opts.desc: No new cost, but Ilya is already at 97% load.

d6.problem: We needed one standard format for every live, so hosting and promotion stop being reinvented each time. Which format do we use?

vars.name: Attendance
vars.ctx: Attendance drives the sales calls booked after the live.

vars.name: Depth of Q&A
vars.ctx: Questions are where objections surface and get answered.

vars.name: Host effort
vars.ctx: Every live is prepared and hosted by the same small team.

opts.name: 60 minutes
opts.desc: 40 min content, 20 min Q&A.

opts.name: 30 minutes
opts.desc: Short and dense, Q&A by email afterwards.

opts.name: 45 minutes and a replay
opts.desc: 30 min content, 15 min Q&A, replay sent the same day.

d7.problem: Spreading a small ad budget across channels gave no usable signal. Do we concentrate it on one channel?

vars.name: Readable cost-per-lead signal
vars.ctx: We need enough volume on a channel to read its cost per lead within 2 weeks.

vars.name: Budget
vars.ctx: The monthly ad budget is fixed for the quarter.

vars.name: Dependence on one channel
vars.ctx: One channel means one algorithm change can cut lead flow overnight.

opts.name: One channel
opts.desc: The whole budget on the channel with the best early CPL.

opts.name: Three channels
opts.desc: Keep the budget split evenly.

opts.name: Two channels
opts.desc: 70 / 30 between the best two channels.

a1.problem: We need one repeatable format before producing the series. Do we build the series on a single masterclass format?

vars.name: Production speed
vars.ctx: A single format lets the playbook and the editor get faster each time.

vars.name: Learner outcomes
vars.ctx: The format must work for decision-making topics of different depth.

vars.name: Brand consistency
vars.ctx: The series must be recognisable at a glance.

opts.name: One format for all
opts.desc: Same structure, length and visual style for every masterclass.

opts.name: Two formats
opts.desc: Short and deep-dive versions.

opts.name: Free format
opts.desc: Each speaker chooses.

a2.problem: We had no proof that people would attend. Do we run a free pilot live before opening sales of the paid series?

vars.name: Learning before spending
vars.ctx: A pilot tests the topic, the host and the funnel before production money is spent.

vars.name: Time to revenue
vars.ctx: A pilot delays the first sale by about 2 weeks.

vars.name: Audience building
vars.ctx: Every pilot sign-up joins the list for the launch.

opts.name: Free pilot live
opts.desc: One free live, then open sales.

opts.name: Paid from day one
opts.desc: Open sales directly.

opts.name: Waitlist only
opts.desc: Collect sign-ups without a live.

a3.problem: Sales follow-up was spread across spreadsheets and inboxes. Do we run all sales follow-up in one CRM?

vars.name: No lead forgotten
vars.ctx: Every lead needs a next action with a date.

vars.name: Adoption by the team
vars.ctx: A tool nobody updates is worse than a spreadsheet.

vars.name: Cost
vars.ctx: Budget is limited to a few seats.

opts.name: One CRM for everything
opts.desc: Pipeline, next actions and notes in one place.

opts.name: Shared spreadsheet
opts.desc: Free and familiar.

opts.name: Inbox and calendar only
opts.desc: No extra tool.

a4.problem: The team needed one moment each week to look at KRs and decide. When do we hold the weekly review?

vars.name: Time to act on it
vars.ctx: Decisions taken in the review should be acted on the same week.

vars.name: Attendance
vars.ctx: All five people must be able to attend.

vars.name: Freshness of data
vars.ctx: Numbers must include the week's results.

opts.name: Friday afternoon
opts.desc: Review the week that ends, plan the next.

opts.name: Monday morning
opts.desc: Start the week with priorities.

opts.name: Wednesday
opts.desc: Mid-week check.

a5.problem: Subtitling took Ilya a full day per masterclass. Do we outsource subtitles?

vars.name: Time freed for Ilya
vars.ctx: Ilya is the bottleneck on content.

vars.name: Cost
vars.ctx: About €80 per masterclass outsourced.

vars.name: Accuracy
vars.ctx: Technical terms must be right.

opts.name: Outsource to a subtitle service
opts.desc: Human-checked subtitles in 48 h.

opts.name: Automatic subtitles only
opts.desc: Free, needs a proofread.

opts.name: Keep in-house
opts.desc: Ilya keeps doing it.
